reason: Checked on the operator's ask, and this one corrects a record of our own. The legacy engine carries Abnormal Security as an ACTIVE prospect (data/prospects.json, last verified 13 Jun 2026) on a thesis of '$5.1B and $200M+ ARR, IPO-track, with the CMO seat in transition'. The trigger under that thesis is the $250M Series D at a $5.1B valuation - announced 6 AUGUST 2024. That is 770 days old, eight times outside the 90-day window, and it was already stale when the June record was written. There has been no round since: Forge marks the company at about $5.07B and Nasdaq Private Market recorded $20.15 per share on 12 Aug 2026, so the price is flat, not re-rating. Total raised remains $546M (Wellington led the Series D, with Greylock, Menlo, Insight and the CrowdStrike Falcon Fund). The rebrand from Abnormal Security to Abnormal AI was 16 Apr 2025, also outside the window. What 2026 actually contains is product and recognition rather than capital: Attune 1.0 on 17 Mar 2026, CNBC Disruptor 50 at No. 46 on 19 May 2026, roughly 25% of the Fortune 500 as customers plus new federal and state agencies. Good company, no event. The decision path also fails the gate outright. Doug Laird is the FORMER chief marketing officer (previously CMO of Carbon Black and of Qlik). Our June record said the CMO seat was 'in transition' and treated that as an opportunity to plant a thesis the incoming hire would inherit; three months later there is still no named CMO, and the most senior marketing name on the company's own leadership page is Keith Mokris, VP of Product and Content Marketing. The standard requires a verified named sponsorship owner, not a vacancy we hope gets filled - so there is no one to address the brief to. Not pitched. The legacy prospect record should not be worked as it stands. Re-open on either of two events: a named CMO or commercial chief arriving, or a Series E, secondary at a new price, or an S-1. Cybersecurity lane occupancy should be re-checked at that point - it has moved since June (1Password exclusive at Red Bull, Rubrik at McLaren from Jan 2026, Cato Networks and SEALSQ at Alpine).
